summary: Mobile app background/resume causes SSE chat stream to stall mid-generation
description: Issue summary: Customer reports that when their mobile app (iOS and Android) backgrounds during a long chat generation and then returns to foreground, the SSE stream frequently becomes silent and never completes the remaining tokens. Impact: Users see the chat UI freeze mid-sentence; approximately 20% of long-response sessions for this customer hit the condition during peak hours. Environment: Dedicated tenant in us-east; traffic flows through our streaming proxy layer to mobile SDK v1.3.2. Observed on both redwood-3b and redwood-4xlarge model profiles.
steps_to_reproduce: Start a long-generation chat (expected >1200 tokens) from mobile app using SSE endpoint
While generation is in progress, background the app (home button / lock screen) for 30-90s
Return the app to foreground and observe client behavior
Repeat across flaky cellular and stable Wi-Fi networks to compare frequency
observed_behavior: After resuming, the SSE connection sometimes reconnects but the stream does not receive any additional token events for >120s. Server-side metrics show the inference worker is still processing (CPU/GPU utilization steady) but no further chunks are emitted to the client. Client logs show no reported socket error or explicit close; the SDK reports 'stream idle' and stops propagating updates to the UI.
expected_behavior: After background/foreground transition the stream should either resume emission of remaining tokens or return a definitive error and a final partial result. The SDK should surface the terminal event to the app so the UI can recover.
logs_and_traces: Client log excerpt (iOS): [2026-03-12T16:21:10Z] SSE connected, [2026-03-12T16:21:29Z] app.didEnterBackground, [2026-03-12T16:22:15Z] app.willEnterForeground, [2026-03-12T16:22:16Z] SSE onmessage: (silence), [2026-03-12T16:24:40Z] SDK streamIdle timeout fired
Proxy access log: request id=fastretail-req-8d5a, upstream worker assigned=worker-71, last downstream write=2026-03-12T16:21:32Z, connection remained open until client resumed
Serving runtime trace: inference job id=job-ff12, started 16:21:02Z, last token emitted to local outbound queue 16:21:33Z, GPU active until 16:23:40Z, no subsequent emit calls logged
Proxy metrics: tcp retransmits increased during background period (cellular) but no TLS renegotiation recorded
impact_summary: Customer experience regression: partial responses left hanging, manual user refresh required. Business impact: elevated support volume and risk of churn on dedicated contract if not resolved within SLA window.
workaround: Short-term: advise customer to cancel generation before backgrounding or enable client-side shorter idle timeout to surface error. We patched SDK to aggressively close / re-establish streams on resume for their mobile app (v1.3.3-beta) which reduced incidents in their staging fleet.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: proxy or mobile SDK is failing to re-associate the client read stream to the outbound chunk queue after TCP inactivity/window changes during backgrounding.
Reproduced internally on Android emulator with cellular throttling: observed similar behavior when background duration >20s and network experienced RTOs.

Serving runtime logs show worker continued producing tokens and enqueuing to outbound buffer but proxy did not flush after resume. Candidate failure points: proxy connection state tracking, TLS session token expiry on mobile OS resume, SDK not sending necessary HTTP/2/connection-level keepalive re-negotiation.

Correlation: affected sessions spike on customer's mobile clients using SDK v1.3.2; customers on SDK v1.2.x have lower incidence. Suggests SDK handshake behavior change in 1.3.x interacting poorly with proxy keepalive semantics.
Related past tickets: SUP-421963 (handoff silence during model swap) shows similar symptom of outbound queue not flushed; reuse lessons from that investigation.
actions_taken: Deployed temporary SDK patch (1.3.3-beta) to FastRetail staging to force reconnect on resume
Enabled verbose proxy flush logging for tenant requests to capture any stalled write attempts
Opened internal issue to add invariant checks in streaming-proxy to detect long-lived idle streams that still have unconsumed outbound buffers
Engineering assigned to debug outbound flush path (assignee: Marco Chen)
Requested customer to provide a few failing request-ids; they provided fastretail-req-8d5a and fastretail-req-8d9c
current_state: Mitigated - workaround in place for customer staging; root cause investigation in progress
resolution_notes: (in progress) SDK work-around reduced occurrence by ~70% for the customer but a permanent fix requires changes in the streaming-proxy and additional tests for mobile OS suspend/resume scenarios. Proposed fix: make proxy detect paused TCP receive window with outbound buffer and proactively resend remaining chunks or terminate with explicit final event. Engineering to plan rollout in next sprint.
follow_up_items: Add mobile suspend/resume test cases to CI for streaming endpoints
Implement proxy outbound-buffer health check and force-flush/terminate path
Coordinate release of SDK v1.3.3 (stable) and notify customer of forced-reconnect option
Postmortem and runbook update linking this class of issue to mobile backgrounding
